dialogues.jp: 「……静かだな」
dialogues.en: "It's quiet......"
dialogues.text: "It's quiet......"

dialogues.jp:
レンタル店で借りてきた洋画を観ながら、コン
ビニ弁当を食べる。
dialogues.en:
I was eating a dinner I bought from a convenience store, and
watching a movie I rented from a video store.
dialogues.text:
I was eating a dinner I bought from a convenience store, and
watching a movie I rented from a video store.

dialogues.jp: ひとりで飯を食べるのは、やっぱ寂しいかな。
dialogues.en:
I felt kind of lonely eating dinner all by myself,
especially when I think that this is going to continue for a
long time......
dialogues.text:
I felt kind of lonely eating dinner all by myself,
especially when I think that this is going to continue for a
long time......

dialogues.jp:
こんなのが、これからもずっと続くのかと思う
と……。
dialogues.en: "I feel depressed......"
dialogues.text: "I feel depressed......"

dialogues.en: Ding dong.
dialogues.text: Ding dong.

dialogues.jp: ――ピンポーン
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp: 「はてっ？」
dialogues.en: Who could be here at this time?
dialogues.text: Who could be here at this time?

dialogues.jp: こんな時間に誰だ？
dialogues.en:
Is it a door-to-door salesman? Mailman? ......Neither one
should come here this late.
dialogues.text:
Is it a door-to-door salesman? Mailman? ......Neither one
should come here this late.

dialogues.jp: 勧誘、集金、宅配……どれもありそうにない。
dialogues.en: I answered the intercom, feeling suspicious.
dialogues.text: I answered the intercom, feeling suspicious.

dialogues.jp: ｛いぶか／訝｝しく思いつつ、インターホンに出る。
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 『あっ、朝倉くん、こんばんは』
dialogues.en: "Oh, good evening, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Oh, good evening, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「萌先輩！？」
dialogues.en: "Moe-sempai!?"
dialogues.text: "Moe-sempai!?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 『はい』
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp:
この声は、確かに萌先輩だ。それにしても、な
ぜ、こんな時間に……。
dialogues.en:
This voice is Moe-sempai for sure. Why's she here this
late......?
dialogues.text:
This voice is Moe-sempai for sure. Why's she here this
late......?

dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと待っててください」
dialogues.en: "I'll be right there."
dialogues.text: "I'll be right there."

dialogues.jp: 受話器を元に戻し、玄関へと向う。
dialogues.en: I hung up the phone and ran to the front door.
dialogues.text: I hung up the phone and ran to the front door.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「こんばんは、朝倉くん」
dialogues.en: "Good evening, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Good evening, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「どうしたんです、こんな時間に？」
dialogues.en: "What are you doing here this late?"
dialogues.text: "What are you doing here this late?"

dialogues.jp:
空港で見かけるようなデカイ鞄が、萌先輩と一
緒に玄関にある。
dialogues.en:
Moe-sempai was standing there with a big suitcase, like the
ones I see at the airport.
dialogues.text:
Moe-sempai was standing there with a big suitcase, like the
ones I see at the airport.

dialogues.jp: まるで家出をしてきたような……。
dialogues.en: It's as if she ran away from home......
dialogues.text: It's as if she ran away from home......

dialogues.jp: （って、ホントに家出じゃないだろうな……）
dialogues.en: (I hope she didn't run away from her home......)
dialogues.text: (I hope she didn't run away from her home......)

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉くんの家に泊まりに来ました」
dialogues.en: "I came to stay in your home."
dialogues.text: "I came to stay in your home."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.jp:
ニッコリ微笑む萌先輩の言葉に、｛とき／刻｝の流れが一
時停止する。
dialogues.en: Time stopped for a moment as she spoke with a smiling face.
dialogues.text: Time stopped for a moment as she spoke with a smiling face.

dialogues.jp: 予想的中！？
dialogues.en: Did she really run away?
dialogues.text: Did she really run away?

dialogues.jp:
ニッコリ微笑む笑顔と、大きな鞄が何よりの証
拠だろう。
dialogues.en: Her smile and her huge luggage are proof enough.
dialogues.text: Her smile and her huge luggage are proof enough.

dialogues.jp: 「あの……本気ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Umm...... Are you serious?"
dialogues.text: "Umm...... Are you serious?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp: にこやかに頷かれ、さらに絶句。
dialogues.en: I was lost for words as she nodded with a smile.
dialogues.text: I was lost for words as she nodded with a smile.

dialogues.jp: 「い、家出？」
dialogues.en: "You ran away from your home?"
dialogues.text: "You ran away from your home?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「いえ、朝倉くんのお世話をしに来たんですけ
　ど……」
dialogues.en: "No, I just came to take care of you......"
dialogues.text: "No, I just came to take care of you......"

dialogues.jp: ちょっと困惑した表情を浮かべてそう言う。
dialogues.en: She spoke with confusion on her face.
dialogues.text: She spoke with confusion on her face.

dialogues.jp:
そりゃそうか。萌先輩の性格で家出なんかあり
えない。もっとも、家出じゃないからって事態
は全然かわらないけど。
dialogues.en:
I see. There's no way Moe-sempai would run away from home.
However this is still a strange situation......
dialogues.text:
I see. There's no way Moe-sempai would run away from home.
However this is still a strange situation......

dialogues.jp:
「いくらなんでも無理です！　この家には俺し
　かいないんだから！」
dialogues.en: "This isn't right! I'm the only person in this house!"
dialogues.text: "This isn't right! I'm the only person in this house!"

dialogues.jp: 女の子とふたりっきりで住むなんて、出来ない。
dialogues.en: I can't live alone with a girl.
dialogues.text: I can't live alone with a girl.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「ですから、朝倉くんのお世話をする人が必要
　じゃないですか。それに一緒に住んでいれば、
　今日のような遅刻はないと思いますし」
dialogues.en:
"That's why you need someone to take care of you. Also if
we're living together, I won't be late picking you up."
dialogues.text:
"That's why you need someone to take care of you. Also if
we're living together, I won't be late picking you up."

dialogues.jp: あたりまえのことのように萌先輩が言う。
dialogues.en:
She explained as if she was saying the right thing. It'dl be
nice to have someone to take care of me, but I can't let a
girl stay here with me.
dialogues.text:
She explained as if she was saying the right thing. It'dl be
nice to have someone to take care of me, but I can't let a
girl stay here with me.

dialogues.jp:
確かに、世話をしてくれる人がいればありがた
いが、だからといって、女の子を泊めるわけに
はいかない。
dialogues.en: "Anyway, I can't let you stay."
dialogues.text: "Anyway, I can't let you stay."

dialogues.jp: 「とにかく、ふたりっきりなんてダメです」
dialogues.en: It would be like we were cohabitating......
dialogues.text: It would be like we were cohabitating......

dialogues.jp: そんな同棲みたいなこと……。
dialogues.en: (Cohabitating, huh......?)
dialogues.text: (Cohabitating, huh......?)

dialogues.jp: （同棲か……）

dialogues.en: ...What the heck am I thinking?
dialogues.text: ...What the heck am I thinking?

dialogues.jp: ――って何を考えてるんだ俺は！
dialogues.en:
I shook my head as I almost lost my conscience to the
tempting word.
dialogues.text:
I shook my head as I almost lost my conscience to the
tempting word.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「お願いします。私、朝倉くんの看病をしたい
　んです」
dialogues.en: "Please. I want to take care of you, Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Please. I want to take care of you, Asakura-kun."

dialogues.jp:
先輩の真剣な眼差しに、何も言えなくなってし
まう。
dialogues.en: I didn't know what to say as I saw her serious face.
dialogues.text: I didn't know what to say as I saw her serious face.

dialogues.jp: 萌先輩なりに責任を感じているのかもしれない。
dialogues.en: I guess Moe-sempai's trying to take responsibility.
dialogues.text: I guess Moe-sempai's trying to take responsibility.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「分かりました……」
dialogues.en: "I understand......"
dialogues.text: "I understand......"

dialogues.jp: それで、先輩の気持ちが楽になるなら――。
dialogues.en: As long as this is going to make her feel better......
dialogues.text: As long as this is going to make her feel better......

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「ありがとうございます」
dialogues.en: "Thank you very much."
dialogues.text: "Thank you very much."

dialogues.jp:
ホッとしたように喜ぶ萌先輩の笑顔を見つめな
がら、なんだかもやもやとしたものを心に感じ
ていた……。
dialogues.en:
As I stared at her relieved smile, I had a fuzzy feeling in
my heart......
dialogues.text:
As I stared at her relieved smile, I had a fuzzy feeling in
my heart......

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あの……あがってもいいですか？」

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「え？　あ、ああ……どうぞ」
dialogues.en: "Umm...... May I come in?"
dialogues.text: "Umm...... May I come in?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい。おじゃまします」
dialogues.en: "Thank you."
dialogues.text: "Thank you."

dialogues.jp:
嬉しそうに微笑むと、萌先輩は靴を脱いで家に
あがりこむ。
dialogues.en:
She took her shoes off and came inside the house with a
joyful smile.
dialogues.text:
She took her shoes off and came inside the house with a
joyful smile.

dialogues.jp: 「こっちへどうぞ」
dialogues.en: "Come this way."
dialogues.text: "Come this way."

dialogues.jp: 「その辺、適当に座っててください」
dialogues.en: "You can sit wherever you like."
dialogues.text: "You can sit wherever you like."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩にソファーを勧め、俺もテレビの前に陣
取り、弁当を手に取る。
dialogues.en:
I told her to sit on the couch, as I sat in front of the TV
to eat my dinner.
dialogues.text:
I told her to sit on the couch, as I sat in front of the TV
to eat my dinner.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「失礼しますね」
dialogues.en: "Thank you."
dialogues.text: "Thank you."

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩が俺の隣に腰かける。身体が｛わず／微｝かに触れ
る距離……萌先輩の体温を感じ、身体が｛ほて／火照｝る。
dialogues.en:
Moe took a seat beside me. Her body was slightly touching
mine...... I felt her temperature and felt the heat inside
of me.
dialogues.text:
Moe took a seat beside me. Her body was slightly touching
mine...... I felt her temperature and felt the heat inside
of me.

dialogues.jp:
こうして並んで座っていると、本当に恋人同士
みたいだ。
dialogues.en: Sitting side by side, I felt as if we were a couple.
dialogues.text: Sitting side by side, I felt as if we were a couple.

dialogues.jp:
冷めはじめたコンビニ弁当を、ぎこちなく口に
運ぶ。
dialogues.en: I ate my cold dinner with an awkward feeling.
dialogues.text: I ate my cold dinner with an awkward feeling.

dialogues.jp:
心臓の鼓動が外に聞こえるんじゃというぐらい、
バクバクいっている。
dialogues.en: I'm afraid she might hear my pounding heartbeat.
dialogues.text: I'm afraid she might hear my pounding heartbeat.

dialogues.jp: なんだか無茶苦茶、意識してしまう……。
dialogues.en: I was feeling extremely conscious of her......
dialogues.text: I was feeling extremely conscious of her......

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「お食事中だったんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Were you eating your dinner?"
dialogues.text: "Were you eating your dinner?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「えっ……うん」
dialogues.en: "What? Yes......"
dialogues.text: "What? Yes......"

dialogues.jp: なに緊張してんだ俺は！　落ち着けって。
dialogues.en: Why am I acting so nervous? Calm down!
dialogues.text: Why am I acting so nervous? Calm down!

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「あの……いつもそういったものを食べている
　んですか？」
dialogues.en: "Umm...... Do you always eat things like that?"
dialogues.text: "Umm...... Do you always eat things like that?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、そうですね。コンビニ、出前、外食。
　……そういったものをローテーションで回し
　てますね」
dialogues.en:
"Well, yes. Either something from the convenience store,
delivery, or restaurants...... I eat those things in
rotation."
dialogues.text:
"Well, yes. Either something from the convenience store,
delivery, or restaurants...... I eat those things in
rotation."

dialogues.jp:
これまでの絶望的な食生活を、お寿司のように
回想する。
dialogues.en: I was recalling my depressing diet in my mind.
dialogues.text: I was recalling my depressing diet in my mind.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「お料理はしないんですか？」
dialogues.en: "You don't cook?"
dialogues.text: "You don't cook?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「たいして作れないんで」
dialogues.en: "I can't really cook."
dialogues.text: "I can't really cook."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、これからは私がお料理をしますね」
dialogues.en: "Well, then I'll cook for you from now on."
dialogues.text: "Well, then I'll cook for you from now on."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「本当ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you serious?"
dialogues.text: "Are you serious?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp: 萌先輩の料理なら願ってもない。
dialogues.en: I love her cooking.
dialogues.text: I love her cooking.

dialogues.jp: （ホントに泊まる気なんだな）
dialogues.en: (So I guess she's really staying here.)
dialogues.text: (So I guess she's really staying here.)

dialogues.jp: 今さらながらに本当にいいのかなと思う。
dialogues.en:
It was too late, but I was still feeling unsure about
this......
dialogues.text:
It was too late, but I was still feeling unsure about
this......

dialogues.jp: 会話が途切れてしまった。
dialogues.en: Our conversation had ended.
dialogues.text: Our conversation had ended.

dialogues.jp:
弁当を食べ終えると、することがなくなってし
まう。
dialogues.en: After I finished eating, there was nothing else to do.
dialogues.text: After I finished eating, there was nothing else to do.

dialogues.jp:
仕方なく、再生中の洋画を眺めているフリをす
るが、やはり隣が気になる。
dialogues.en:
I pretended like I was watching the movie, but was still
conscious of her.
dialogues.text:
I pretended like I was watching the movie, but was still
conscious of her.

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩も俺にならって、テレビ画面を見ている。
その無防備な横顔を、俺はちらちらと落ち着き
なく見ていた。
dialogues.en:
Moe was also watching the TV screen like me. I was peeking
at her innocent face every chance I got.
dialogues.text:
Moe was also watching the TV screen like me. I was peeking
at her innocent face every chance I got.

dialogues.speaker: Actress
dialogues.en: (Huh?)
dialogues.text: (Huh?)

dialogues.jp: 突然の｛つや／艶｝やかな声にテレビ画面を見ると。
dialogues.en: Suddenly, I heard a sexy voice coming out of the TV......
dialogues.text: Suddenly, I heard a sexy voice coming out of the TV......

dialogues.speaker: Actress
dialogues.jp: （やばっ、この映画キスシーンがあったのか）
dialogues.en: (Shoot! I didn't know they had a love scene in this movie!)
dialogues.text: (Shoot! I didn't know they had a love scene in this movie!)

dialogues.jp:
頬が一気に紅潮する。心臓が、身体の中で飛び
散りそうだ。
dialogues.en: I blushed suddenly, My heart was ready to explode.
dialogues.text: I blushed suddenly, My heart was ready to explode.

dialogues.jp:
いきなりここで話し始めたら、動揺バレバレだ
し、かと言って、いきなり再生を止めるわけに
もいかないし……。
dialogues.en:
If I started talking to her now, she'll know I'm in a panic.
However, I can't just stop the movie now......
dialogues.text:
If I started talking to her now, she'll know I'm in a panic.
However, I can't just stop the movie now......

dialogues.jp: （頼む……早く終わってくれ……）
dialogues.en: (Please...... Get over with this scene......)
dialogues.text: (Please...... Get over with this scene......)

dialogues.jp: 終われ――終わるんだ！
dialogues.en: Please end! Right now!
dialogues.text: Please end! Right now!

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.en: "What? What is it......?"
dialogues.text: "What? What is it......?"

dialogues.jp:
いきなり萌先輩が口を開いたので、マジで喉か
ら心臓が飛び出しそうになる。
dialogues.en:
My heart almost came out of my mouth as she spoke to me all
of a sudden.
dialogues.text:
My heart almost came out of my mouth as she spoke to me all
of a sudden.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「こんなにいっぱいキスをして、酸っぱくない
　んでしょうか？」
dialogues.en: "Would it taste sour to kiss as much as they are?"
dialogues.text: "Would it taste sour to kiss as much as they are?"

dialogues.jp:
めちゃくちゃ動揺しているせいか、言っている
ことが解からない。
dialogues.en: I was so nervous that I didn't understand what she meant.
dialogues.text: I was so nervous that I didn't understand what she meant.

dialogues.jp: 「あの……どうして？」
dialogues.en: "Umm...... Why are you saying that?"
dialogues.text: "Umm...... Why are you saying that?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「いえ……キスってレモンの味がするって言う
　じゃないですか」
dialogues.en: "Well...... They say that a kiss tastes like a lemon."
dialogues.text: "Well...... They say that a kiss tastes like a lemon."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「だから、こんなにいっぱいキスしたら、とて
　も酸っぱいと思うんです」
dialogues.en: "So, if you kiss that much, I think it'll be too sour."
dialogues.text: "So, if you kiss that much, I think it'll be too sour."

dialogues.jp: 「いや……たぶん大丈夫なんじゃないですか」
dialogues.en: "No...... I think they're fine."
dialogues.text: "No...... I think they're fine."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「そうなんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Really?"
dialogues.text: "Really?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「萌先輩、キスしたことないんですか？」
dialogues.en: "You've never kissed before, Moe-sempai?"
dialogues.text: "You've never kissed before, Moe-sempai?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "No I haven't."
dialogues.text: "No I haven't."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、試してみます？」
dialogues.en: "Then would you like to try?"
dialogues.text: "Then would you like to try?"

dialogues.jp: って、俺はなに言ってんだ。
dialogues.en: What the heck am I suggesting?
dialogues.text: What the heck am I suggesting?

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Sure."
dialogues.text: "Sure."

dialogues.en: ----What?
dialogues.text: ----What?

dialogues.jp: スッと立ち上がった萌先輩が、俺の前に立つ。
dialogues.en: Moe stood up and came in front of me.
dialogues.text: Moe stood up and came in front of me.

dialogues.jp: 「萌せん――」
dialogues.en: "Moe-sem..."
dialogues.text: "Moe-sem..."

dialogues.jp: やわ……らかい……。
dialogues.en: She bent her body down and licked my lips with her tongue.
dialogues.text: She bent her body down and licked my lips with her tongue.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「……レモンの味……しませんね……？」

俺の顔の目の前で、萌先輩がきょとんとした眼
差しを向けてくる。
dialogues.en: Her tongue was making a wet sound.
dialogues.text: Her tongue was making a wet sound.

dialogues.jp: 「そ、そうですね……」
dialogues.en: I felt her warm tongue all over my lips.
dialogues.text: I felt her warm tongue all over my lips.

dialogues.jp:
こんなに間近で、そんな瞳で見つめられたら
……理性がもたないです……。

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「あの……もしかして、今のは本当のキスでは
　ないのでしょうか？」
dialogues.en: "......It doesn't taste like a lemon......"
dialogues.text: "......It doesn't taste like a lemon......"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「いや……俺にも分からないです……」
dialogues.en: "Umm...... Perhaps that wasn't a real kiss?"
dialogues.text: "Umm...... Perhaps that wasn't a real kiss?"

dialogues.jp:
もはや心の中でツッこむ余裕もなく、上の空で
答える。フワフワと、身体が浮いているような
錯覚にとらわれる。
dialogues.en: "Well...... I'm not very sure......"
dialogues.text: "Well...... I'm not very sure......"

dialogues.jp: ――それだけ、舞い上がってるってことか。
dialogues.en:
I answered vaguely as I couldn't focus in my mind. I felt as
if my body was floating in the air.
dialogues.text:
I answered vaguely as I couldn't focus in my mind. I felt as
if my body was floating in the air.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「そうですか……じゃあ、今度調べてみますね」
dialogues.en: "I see...... I'll research more then."
dialogues.text: "I see...... I'll research more then."

dialogues.jp: ニッコリ微笑み、再びテレビに視線を移す。
dialogues.en: She smiled and looked back at the TV.
dialogues.text: She smiled and looked back at the TV.

dialogues.jp:
俺もテレビに目を向ける。そっと唇に手をやる
と指先がしっとり濡れた。
dialogues.en:
I also looked at the TV. As I softly touched my lips, I felt

dialogues.en:
I continued to touch my lips as I watched the rest of the
movie with her......

dialogues.en: ◆The flavor of a kiss◆

一人寂しく食事を取っていると、萌先輩がやっ
て来た。責任を感じたのか、俺の看病をしたい
と言うのだ。
dialogues.en:
When I was eating my dinner alone, Moe-sempai came to the
house. She wanted to take the responsibility of taking care
of me.

dialogues.jp:
何となく、レンタルしてきたビデオを見ている
と、突然、画面から艶やかな声が。
dialogues.en:
When we were watching the movie I rented, I started hearing
a sexy voice from the screen.

dialogues.jp:
すると、萌先輩は突然、キスの味がどうのこう
の言ってきたのだ。レモンの味……？
dialogues.en:
All of a sudden, Moe-sempai started asking me about the
flavor of a kiss. Does it taste like a lemon......?
